component.name: PayShield
component.summary: Stop invoice & routing scams — seal and check documents locally

description.p: PayShield checks every invoice, statement, receipt, scanned check or KYC document right on your own machine. It seals the file with SHA-256, scans it for scam signals, and warns you the instant the account number — or crypto wallet — isn't the one you expected. One click. Nothing leaves your device.
For households, freelancers, small businesses, crypto users and anyone doing KYC.

screenshot.caption: Seal and scam-check an invoice — entirely on your machine
